approaches.title: Interior-region detection and capture
approaches.summary: Scans interior cells, recursively determines whether each connected region reaches the boundary, and captures regions that do not. Uses a separate visited grid and a second recursive pass to convert capturable cells to X.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduces recursive region validation with a visited grid, followed by recursive capture of enclosed O regions.

approaches.title: Boundary flood fill with temporary safe markers
approaches.summary: Flood-fills O regions connected to the boundary, marking them as safe before converting remaining O cells to X. This reverses the problem by preserving boundary-connected regions rather than testing every interior region.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces interior capture checks with boundary-based flood fill using S as a temporary safe marker, then restores safe cells and captures the rest.
Keeps the boundary flood-fill strategy while avoiding redundant calls, accepting slices in mark_safe, and skipping duplicate corner processing.
